Prgm
    { prgmObjMap = ObjectMap
        { omItems = fromList
            [
                ( "/System/env"
                , ObjectMapItem
                    { omiDecls = []
                    , omiRuntimeDecls =
                        [ /System/env
                            ( EAppArg { eaaArg = Value /name -> ∀/Data/String } )
                            ( EAppArg { eaaArg = Value /this -> /Catln/IO.. } ) -> ∀/Data/Maybe[ /T=∀/Data/String ]
                        ]
                    , omiRefineDecls = []
                    , omiDefs = []
                    }
                )
            ]
        }
    , prgmCg = [ CGType ]
    , prgmAnnots =
        [ /Catln/#md
            ( EAppArg
                { eaaArg = Value /text -> /Data/String/Text
                    ( /chars=∀/Data/List/ConsList[ /T=/Data/Char ] ) = "# Environment
                  What a program can read of the environment it was started in. It is a method of [/Catln/IO]
                  because it reaches outside the program: a run started with different variables set answers
                  differently, so reading one is an effect, and a program can only do it where it holds an IO
                  value to do it through.
                  This is not part of the standard library. A program which reads no variable has no use for it,
                  and one that does writes `import "env"`."
                }
            )
        ]
    }
